servicesIntro: Open 6:30am to 6pm, Monday to Friday, 50 weeks a year.

services.name: Nursery
services.desc: Six weeks to 2 years, in a calm room with its own sleep space.

services.name: Toddlers
services.desc: 2 to 3 years, lots of outdoor play and early words.

services.name: Kindy
services.desc: 3 to 5 years, a Queensland-approved kindergarten program.

feesIntro: Daily fees before the Child Care Subsidy. Most families pay much less; we'll work it out with you on the tour.

process.title: Book a tour
process.desc: Meet the educators and see the rooms, about 30 minutes.

process.title: Pick your days
process.desc: Two days a week minimum, and we'll check your subsidy.

process.title: Settling-in visits
process.desc: Two short free visits before the first full day.

faq.a: For the nursery, usually. Join it after your tour; it's free.

faq.q: What do I need to bring?
faq.a: A hat, a water bottle and a change of clothes. We supply the rest.

faq.q: Can I pick different days each week?
faq.a: Set days work best for the children, but we'll try to help.
